crossRefs.note: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not…
and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly…

translations.web: but they only heard: “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
translations.bsb: They only heard the account: “The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy.”
translations.kjv: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
translations.asv: but they only heard say, He that once persecuted us now preacheth the faith of which he once made havoc;
